name: Uto Zen
source:
An heir of a wealthy family who is rather hedonistic.

He is the third son of a certain company and has been an insider in the entertainment district since childhood. He lives life in the moment, following the motto, “It’s fine as long as I’m having fun now.” He values his childhood friends Chigaya and Luka more than his own family.
